name: Isogashi kata no tame no Zombie Police
original_name: 忙しい方のためのゾンビポリス
source:
[b]Zombie Police[/b] - A mystery series featuring an unlikely detective duo: a zombie and a human!

This new bite-sized entry is a high-paced comedy perfect for busy mystery lovers who want their mysteries light and breezy.
No horror or gore here - just instant game-overs if you slip up!

Breeze through investigations and deductions while enjoying a story filled with quirky, lovable characters!

[From [url=https://lobstudio.itch.io/mini-zombie]itch.io[/url]]
